start.greeting: 👋 Send any supported YouTube link. Use /help for details.
help.body: 🤖 How to use YOTG Media Bot 1. Paste a YouTube or YouTube Music link. 2. I fetch the media in the best quality available (up to 1080p). 3. Receive the audio or video right here. Supported sources • YouTube Music → tagged audio with cover art. • YouTube → MP4 video up to 1080p. Commands /start – restart the bot and auto-detect your locale. /help – show this menu. /settings – choose your preferred language.
help.admin: Admin commands /add {user_id} – grant access /remove {user_id} – revoke access /op {user_id} – promote to admin (root only) /deop {user_id} – demote admin (root only) Or forward a user's message to grant access instantly.
error.generic: ❌ Oops, could not process the link.
error.too_large: ⚠️ The file is too large for Telegram bots (max ~{limit_mb} MB). Try a shorter video or lower quality.
admin.access_granted_user: ✅ Access granted. Send YouTube links here to start downloading.
admin.error_generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
admin.missing_id: Please provide a numeric Telegram user ID.
admin.only_root: Only the root admin can manage other admins.
admin.demoted: ⚠️ User {user_id} is now a regular user.
